families.name: Sculptural Liquid Chrome
families.tagline: Dense Viscous Mercury & Hydraulic Heavy Metal
families.description: Heavy, dense liquid mercury forms exhibiting organic fluid tension necks, meniscus droplets, spires, and chiseled metallic pillars. Photographed in an infinite obsidian void with extreme specular contrast and mirror reflections.
characteristics: Photorealistic mirror chrome and liquid mercury textures
Fluid tension necks and hanging meniscus beads
High-contrast directional studio lighting
Deep charcoal and pure black void negative space
Organic fluid spires, hydraulic crowns, and viscous pillars

families.tagline: Nacreous Luster, Soft White Sheen & Velvety Silk

families.name: Translucent Glass Membrane
families.tagline: Vitreous Films, Diaphanous Sails & Caustic Dispersion

Deep ultraviolet and pale-cyan chromatic caustics
Gossamer-thin fluid sails and billowing sheets
Refractive bubbles and capillary fluid webbing
Curling wave crests peeling into glass-like film

Continuous circular fluid tension and hydraulic orbital loops
Concentric standing wave ripples inside circular apertures
Geometric purity meets fluid distortion
